task: Revive ai-run-demo-agents to a working state and verify/document two demo agents (one streaming, one complete-response) that run independently without CodeMie.

key_reasoning.reason: Work spans multiple independent agent packages (choosing/repairing among currency_converter, financial-agent, fun-with-rick, research-agent), root README, and per-agent docs/config — no single component owns the task. Bumped from M to L: the change affects multiple agents/workflows (red flag).

Core ask is defined (two agents, one streaming + one complete, basic checks, docs), but several design decisions are open: which two agents to designate as the demo pair given financial-agent is currently broken (yfinance→curl_cffi native build failure) and fun-with-rick has a dead tavily tool reference; how 'verifiable without CodeMie' is satisfied given every agent needs a real LLM credential; whether to fix the native dependency or route around it.

Closest existing pattern is strong — every agent's agent.py already implements both invoke() (complete) and stream() (incremental), and research-agent/test_client.py is a reusable template for the 'basic checks' criterion — so most of the work is copy-and-verify, not new architecture. Kept at M rather than bumped: no security/auth/schema work, and the one real risk (financial-agent's native-build failure) is avoidable by choosing already-working agents (currency_converter, research-agent) rather than a hard blocker to route around.

Touches agent/reasoning layer (verification only), transport/protocol layer (verification only), packaging/config (fixing or avoiding the financial-agent dependency break, possibly adding .env.example), and documentation (stale root README, per-agent README gaps) — a standard 2-3 layer path with no schema or new external integration.

red_flags_applied: Component Scope bumped from M to L: task affects multiple agents/workflows (choice among 4 candidate agent packages plus root-level docs/config, not one self-contained component).
